guards.description: DELETE calls owned and enforces tenant ownership; do not claim cancellation authorization is missing.
Worker termination/cancellation effectiveness and identity-provider behavior are external, not established failures or passes.

evidence.quote: Cancellation's worker effect is outside scope.

coverage.description: Assess how POST binds new jobs to verified tenant identity.
Trace GET lookup through result return and authorization, if present.
Trace DELETE and the shared ownership helper; distinguish worker effects.
